hero.label: EnduranceIQ
hero.headline: A smart second opinion on your marathon training.
hero.subhead: EnduranceIQ reads your watch data and tells you what you're doing wrong, why it matters, and what to change.
hero.ctaSampleDesc: See what it looks like before signing up.

problem.p1: Most self-coached marathon runners train too hard on their easy days and don't know it.
problem.p2: Wearables show the data. They don't interpret it.
problem.p3: Real example: 8 consecutive runs across 2 weeks averaging 154–176 bpm, with zero Zone 2 running. The runner didn't notice until the analysis surfaced it.

features.title: What you'll get every week
features.intensityBody: Compare your week to the 80/20 research target. See exactly how much of your training was easy, moderate, and hard — and why that matters.
features.loadBody: Plain-language status: Normal, Elevated, Spike, Low. With a 4-week baseline so you know if you're building too fast.
features.strengthBody: One focused session per week, tied to what your running data shows. Scheduling included — no guessing when to lift.

methodology.headline: Every recommendation cites the research behind it.
methodology.p1: Intensity distribution targets come from polarised training research. Training load thresholds follow acute/chronic workload methodology. Strength recommendations cite running economy and injury prevention literature. Nothing is made up.
methodology.p2: All citations link to the published paper. When a DOI resolves to a 404, we replace it. When evidence is moderate rather than strong, we say so.

cta.headline: Connect your Strava, get your first report in 2 minutes.
cta.subhead: Free to use. No credit card required.
